doc: Allocates an object via func_8003FC64(0). If allocation fails, returns NULL. Otherwise takes the embedded sub-object at offset 0x20, initializes it via func_8004FC68, computes/stores an index or size via func_8004FD78(sub, a0) into sub+0x30, then validates via func_8004FC98(sub). On validation failure it tears the object down with func_8004FE78 and returns NULL; on success it installs the object's vtable function pointer (func_8004FC2C at offset 0x10 of the outer object) and the sub-object's callback function pointer (func_8004F9AC at offset 0x00 of the sub-object), then returns the object pointer.
